verdicts.decision_note: The client requests a revised visible spout form that more closely matches the supplied diagram, establishing an implementation-relevant mechanical and visual design requirement.
The freelancer raises a material unresolved choice between reproducing the rendered spout and using an off-the-shelf alternative within the first-edition scope.
The client accepts custom stainless-steel fabrication and requires the spout’s visible form to match the rendering as closely as possible; no obsolete state keys require removal.
The client resolves the first-edition scope uncertainty by authorizing the proposed custom rendered-spout approach.
